note: Meshes whose simple collision (one UCX hull from the ground up) covers a tread the render mesh shows. Scan numbers come from the source FBX in Blender units (cm, front is -Y). x and y are the buried tread's extent, z its height, buried_cm how far the hull reaches over it, hull the UCX box as [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax]. placed is the instance count on the map. Tools/fix_stair_collision_341.py switches the fix list to complex as simple; GFGame.Movement.StairKit.TownCollision asserts it.
